name: coherence-companion
description: A companion for play, exploration, learning, creation and connection through shared interests and paths, with choices and sharing in your hands.

interface.longDescription: Bring curiosity, a playful invitation, a wish to connect, or something you want help with. Enjoy shared stories, explore ideas, learn, create and follow interests at your own pace. Choose what to save or share. Community discovery uses your host's available tools and sources. Open-source guidance uses your host's data controls; optional Coherence Network tools are configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Let's invent an imaginary place together, just for fun.
Explore something that sparks my curiosity with me.
Help me explore communities around interests I choose to share.
